note: English post has productCount 0 (guide); the Sunwayfoto ET-01 and Benro extension column are reference rows in a spec table, the MT055XPRO3 an example in a calculation. The English body already has 3 outside links, so local facts are named in the text without extra links.

productFit.name: Sunwayfoto ET-01 Carbon Fiber Tripod Extension Tube (reference row in the spec table; not a product block)
productFit.metricSpecs: Keep the English B&H figures converted: 30 cm (12 in) extra, 19 cm (7.4 in) folded, 116 g (4.1 oz), 10 kg (22 lb).
productFit.reason: Sold worldwide through the maker's own international store (sunwayfoto.com) under the same ET-01 code; no local-availability claim in the post.

productFit.name: Benro carbon fiber extension column (reference row; not a product block)
productFit.metricSpecs: Benro gives the metric figure itself: extends to a maximum of 16 inches (40.5 cm).
productFit.reason: Only Benro USA pages found for the extension columns; no EU dealer page checked. Not a product block, so no note is needed; no availability claim in the post.

productFit.name: Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 (example tripod in the height calculation)
productFit.metricSpecs: Manfrotto global-de: 140 cm with the centre column down, 170 cm max (matches B&H 55 in).
productFit.reason: Sold in the EU under the same code (Manfrotto German maker page).

localFacts.fact: CBS: Dutch-born 19-year-old men were on average 182,9 cm tall in 2020, so many Dutch readers are near the post's 1,88 m example.
Benro gives the extension column's metric maximum itself: 16 inches (40,5 cm).
Dutch terms: verlengstuk / verlengkolom (extension column), middenzuil of middenkolom, statiefkop, schroefdraad 1/4" en 3/8".

localPainPoints.pain: The centre column is the least stable part of the tripod, so Dutch photographers keep it down outdoors.
localPainPoints.fix: An extension column behaves the same; legs first, column last and short.

quotes.text: De middenzuil is het minst stabiele gedeelte van je statief.
Nu zal ik de middenzuil buiten niet zo snel omhoog zetten in verband met het verlies van stabiliteit

localGain.point: CBS average height: the 1,88 m example is close to the Dutch average young man.
Dutch voices (fotografieles.nl, Photofacts) on the middenzuil as the weakest part.
